title: ABI: Actor-Free Behavior-Induced Representations for Zero-Shot Test-Time Guidance
abstract: arXiv:2611.30636v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Behavior-cloning policies show strong ability in sequential control by generating coherent multi-step action chunks, yet their purely imitative objective limits zero-shot generalization to unseen tasks. While offline reinforcement learning offers principled policy improvement, existing methods either require task-specific reward supervision or remain tied to a specific actor during critic training or policy deployment, inflating training cost and restricting cross-policy generalization. We observe that evaluating actions under the data-collecting behavior largely preserves their relative value ordering across target policies, offering a way around actor coupling. Combining this property with reward-free successor prediction, we propose Actor-Free Behavior-Induced Representations (ABI) to learn multi-horizon action-chunk representations from unlabeled trajectories without reward supervision or actor training. translated_title: ABI：面向零样本测试时引导的无Actor行为诱导表征
translated_abstract: 行为克隆策略通过生成连贯的多步动作块，在序贯控制任务中展现出强大的能力，但其纯粹的模仿目标限制了其在未见任务上的零样本泛化能力。虽然离线强化学习提供了有原则的策略改进途径，但现有方法要么需要任务特定的奖励监督，要么在评论家训练或策略部署过程中仍与特定的Actor相绑定，从而推高了训练成本并限制了跨策略的泛化能力。我们观察到，在数据收集行为策略下评估动作，能够在很大程度上保持其在不同目标策略之间的相对价值排序，这为绕开Actor耦合提供了一条途径。将这一特性与免奖励的后继预测相结合，我们提出了无Actor行为诱导表征，从无标注轨迹中学习多时域的动作块表征，而无需奖励监督或Actor训练。在测试时，将该表征与……（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出无Actor的行为诱导表征（ABI），无需奖励监督或Actor训练，即可从无标注离线轨迹中学习多时域动作块表征，实现零样本的测试时策略引导，摆脱了任务奖励依赖与Actor耦合的限制。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Actor-Free Behavior-Induced Representations (ABI), which learn multi-horizon action-chunk representations from unlabeled, reward-free trajectories, enabling zero-shot test-time policy guidance without reward supervision or actor coupling.
